All callers of discardScratch pass the result of scratchFolderFor, which creates a deterministic parent directory. Specifically: (1) In index.ts:567-576, scanDir is created by scratchFolderFor(scanOutputDir) and passed to discardScratch in the finally block. (2) In link.ts:118, scratch is created by scratchFolderFor(out) and passed to discardScratch in the catch block. There is no public API or realistic input path that allows an attacker to control the scratch parameter independently of scratchFolderFor.
